description: This file implements a Screenshotter class for capturing screenshots of web pages or elements, including handling styles, animations, masking, and clipping. It also includes utility functions for preparing the page and validating options.

classes.name: Screenshotter
classes.description: Handles taking screenshots of pages or elements with options for style, masking, and clipping.

classes.name: TaskQueue
classes.description: A simple promise-based task queue to serialize screenshot tasks.

methods.name: _originalViewportSize
methods.description: Gets the current viewport size, either from emulation or by querying window.innerWidth/Height.

methods.name: _fullPageSize
methods.description: Calculates the full size of the page content for full-page screenshots.

methods.name: screenshotPage
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the entire page based on options.

methods.name: screenshotElement
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of a specific DOM element.

methods.name: _preparePageForScreenshot
methods.description: Prepares the page by disabling animations, hiding carets, and waiting for fonts.

methods.name: _restorePageAfterScreenshot
methods.description: Restores the page state after screenshot by cleaning up styles and event listeners.

methods.name: _maskElements
methods.description: Applies masking to specified elements for the screenshot.

methods.name: _screenshot
methods.description: Performs the actual screenshot operation, handling background, masking, and quality.
